from collections import Counter

ROOT = Path('F:/ChnobelRuntime/reviews/adr0004-ratifikation-01')

SPEC = Path('F:/ChnobelRuntime/specification/v2-manifest-draft-01')

HEAD = 'd802c8d64b0b50d89cc13432871aca81c308b68d'
BEFORE = '789e5c0e0d06f1d44313dddf1be343c2807e200d'
MAIN = '9bab69c078f2c7dbfbca3b548ce1c8ef24a9ab61'
BALLOT = 'eaabc21a38b1bdc806f37444a6bdee00991004b462f9066d521cbb4b732d3b3c'
BRIEF = '90528cb018b77674c2f2c65a3598f8864e036baeff1052f128449ce1d8bfa244'

CONTEXTS = {str(REPO/'steuerung'/n).replace('\\','/') for n in ['STATUS.md','BLOCKER.md','WIEDERAUFNAHME.md']}

def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def load(p): return json.loads(Path(p).read_bytes())
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(REPO),*args])
def norm(b): return b.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
def variants(b):
    b = norm(b)
    return [b,b.replace(b'\n',b'\r\n')]
def file_binding(p):
    b = Path(p).read_bytes()
    return {'path':Path(p).as_posix(),'sha256':sha(b),'bytes':len(b)}
def at(obj,pointer):
    for k in pointer.lstrip('/').split('/'):
        k = k.replace('~1','/').replace('~0','~')
        obj = obj[int(k)] if isinstance(obj,list) else obj[k]
    return obj

assert sys.dont_write_bytecode
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip() == HEAD
assert git('status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all') == b''
refs = dict(row.split()[::-1] for row in git('ls-remote','--heads','origin','refs/heads/main','refs/heads/ci/entwicklungspruefung').decode().splitlines())
assert refs == {'refs/heads/main':MAIN,'refs/heads/ci/entwicklungspruefung':HEAD}
assert sha((ROOT/'ballot.md').read_bytes()) == BALLOT
assert sha((ROOT/'brief.md').read_bytes()) == BRIEF
assert (ROOT/'ballot.md').read_bytes() == (REPO/'docs/adr/0004-zusammengesetzter-kindbeleg-entwurf.md').read_bytes()
assert not git('diff',BEFORE,HEAD,'--','produkt','pruefung','.github','docs/adr','AGENTS.md','CLAUDE.md','MASTERPROMPT.md','steuerung/auftraege')
# Prior two votes remain bound to their completed, archived parent evidence.
prior_path = Path('F:/ChnobelRuntime/verification/adr0004-part01/verification.json')
assert sha(prior_path.read_bytes()) == 'ade38db3558a6c0825ef9ce5dd710239c536f68d1fac25e6d927a365f2fca546'
prior = load(prior_path)
assert prior['result'] == 'PASS_RETURN_BINDINGS_ONLY'
assert prior['voteCounts'] == {'JA':2}
arch_root = REPO/'steuerung/gedaechtnis/entscheide/2026-11-27-adr0004-voten-teil01'
arch_index = load(arch_root/'index.json')
assert arch_index['fileCount'] == len(arch_index['files']) == 10
for x in arch_index['files']:
    b = (arch_root/x['file']).read_bytes(); container = json.loads(b)
    assert sha(b) == x['containerSha256'] and len(b) == x['containerByteCount']
    original = ''.join(container['lines']).encode('utf-8')
    assert original == Path(x['sourcePath']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(original) == x['contentSha256'] and len(original) == x['originalByteCount']
roles = []
for r in prior['roles']:
    role = r['role']; v = load(ROOT/role/'vote.json'); s = load(ROOT/role/'sources.json')
    for name,digest in r['files'].items(): assert sha((ROOT/role/name).read_bytes()) == digest
    assert v['scopeStatus'] == 'COMPLETE' and v['vote'] == 'JA'
    assert v['wholeDocument'] is True and v['unconditional'] is True and v['proposedTextChanges'] == []
    if role == 'architekt': assert v['additionalConditions'] == []
    else: assert 'Zustimmung ohne neue Bedingung oder verlangte Aenderung.' in v['rationale']
    assert v['ballotSha256Before'] == v['ballotSha256After'] == BALLOT
    immutable = s['immutable'] if role == 'didaktik' else s['verification']['immutableSources']
    assert len({x['path'] for x in immutable}) == len(immutable) == r['immutableSourcesVerified']
    for x in immutable: assert sha(Path(x['path']).read_bytes()) == x['sha256Before'] == x['sha256After']
    roles.append({'role':role,'vote':v['vote'],'scopeStatus':'COMPLETE','wholeDocument':True,'unconditional':True,'immutableSourcesVerified':len(immutable),'files':r['files'],'parentEvidence':file_binding(prior_path),'mutableContextEvidence':'Prior parent reconstruction retained; no assertion that old mutable snapshots equal current files.'})
# Third vote: full metadata, sources, allowed context changes and event references.
for name,digest in RED.items(): assert sha((ROOT/'redteam'/name).read_bytes()) == digest
v = load(ROOT/'redteam/vote.json'); s = load(ROOT/'redteam/sources.json')
assert v['role'] == 'redteam' and v['scopeStatus'] == 'COMPLETE' and v['vote'] == 'JA'
assert v['wholeDocument'] is True and v['unconditional'] is True
assert v['conditions'] == [] and v['proposedTextChanges'] == []
assert v['ballotSha256Before'] == v['ballotSha256After'] == BALLOT
assert v['repoBallotSha256Before'] == v['repoBallotSha256After'] == BALLOT
assert v['briefSha256Before'] == v['briefSha256After'] == BRIEF
assert v['reportSha256'] == RED['report.md'] and v['sourcesSha256'] == RED['sources.json']
assert v['wholeManifestVerdict'] == 'NOT_ISSUED' and v['implementationAuthorized'] is False and v['ratificationIssued'] is False
assert set(v['sectionAssessments']) == {'Anlass/Dissens','A1','A2','A3','A4','A5','Versionen','Verfahren/Sperren'}
assert all(x['status']=='COMPLETE' for x in v['sectionAssessments'].values())
assert not any(x['blocksApprovalOfThisBallot'] or x['requiresBallotTextChange'] or x['closedByThisVote'] for x in v['findings'])
assert v['independence']['newOtherRoleFilesRead'] is False and v['independence']['newOtherRoleArchivesRead'] is False
before_by_id = {x['id']:x for x in s['immutable']}
after_by_id = {x['id']:x for x in s['afterBindings']['immutable']}
vote_by_id = {x['id']:x for x in v['sourceBindings']['immutable']}
assert len(before_by_id) == len(s['immutable']) == s['mechanicalVerification']['immutableCount'] == 39
assert before_by_id.keys() == after_by_id.keys() == vote_by_id.keys()
for key,b in before_by_id.items():
    a = after_by_id[key]; q = vote_by_id[key]
    assert b['path'] == a['path'] == q['path']
    assert sha(Path(b['path']).read_bytes()) == b['sha256Before'] == a['sha256After'] == q['sha256Before'] == q['sha256After']
    assert a['unchanged'] is True and q['unchanged'] is True
contexts = []
assert {x['path'] for x in s['mutableContexts']} == CONTEXTS
for b in s['mutableContexts']:
    key=b['id']; a=next(x for x in s['afterBindings']['mutableContexts'] if x['id']==key)
    d=next(x for x in s['afterBindings']['mutableContextDiffs'] if x['id']==key)
    q=next(x for x in v['sourceBindings']['mutableContexts'] if x['id']==key)
    rel=Path(b['path']).relative_to(REPO).as_posix()
    old=git('show',BEFORE+':'+rel); new=git('show',HEAD+':'+rel); current=Path(b['path']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(old)==d['beforeGitBlobSha256'] and sha(new)==d['afterGitBlobSha256']
    assert b['sha256Before']==d['beforeRawSha256']==q['sha256Before']
    assert b['sha256Before'] in {sha(x) for x in variants(old)}
    assert sha(current)==a['sha256After']==d['afterRawSha256']==q['sha256After']
    assert norm(current)==norm(new)
    assert sha(d['exactCommitDiffUtf8'].encode('utf-8'))==d['exactCommitDiffSha256']
    assert norm(git('diff',BEFORE,HEAD,'--',rel))==norm(d['exactCommitDiffUtf8'].encode('utf-8'))
    contexts.append({'path':b['path'],'beforeRawSha256':b['sha256Before'],'afterRawSha256':a['sha256After'],'beforeCommit':BEFORE,'afterCommit':HEAD,'diffSha256':d['exactCommitDiffSha256'],'rawAndGitNewlinesSeparated':True})
index=load(SPEC/'case-index.json'); base=load(SPEC/'case-index-base.json')
ids=set(v['reviewScope']['mainCaseIds'])|{x['caseId'] for x in v['reviewScope']['counterControls']}
selected={x['id']:x for x in index if x['id'] in ids}
assert len(selected)==5 and selected=={x['id']:x for x in base if x['id'] in ids}
input_docs={}

        ref=e[kind]; raw=(SPEC/ref['path']).read_bytes()
        assert sha(raw)==ref['sha256'] and len(raw)==ref['bytes']
    input_docs[cid]=load(SPEC/e['input']['path'])
for control in v['reviewScope']['counterControls']:

assert len(report.split())==v['reportWordsWhitespace']

assert event['seq']==2 and event['type']=='support.presented' and event['actor']=='app'
assert event['payload']['effect']=='hinweis' and event['payload']['target']=='ten.step'
assert input_docs[t05['caseId']]['events'][3]['payload']['sinceSeq']==3
assert not any(e['type']=='observation.invalidated' for e in input_docs[t05['caseId']]['events'])
assert load(SPEC/selected[t05['caseId']]['oracle']['path'])['facts']['support.general']=='unbekannt'

roles.append({'role':'redteam','vote':'JA','scopeStatus':'COMPLETE','wholeDocument':True,'unconditional':True,'immutableSourcesVerified':39,'files':RED,'mutableContexts':contexts,'reportEventAndItemReferencesVerified':len(report_ids),'preservedFindings':v['findings']})

assert sha((DIG/'handoff.json').read_bytes())=='a48f0aca352d6c98abb7bca922722533cd54df799119c79bbe250b1ee5441376'

    raw=(DIG/x['path']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(raw)==x['sha256'] and len(raw)==x['bytes']
assert len(h['immutableSources'])==h['immutableSourceCount']==len(ds['immutableSources'])==39
for x in ds['immutableSources']:
    raw=Path(x['path']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(raw)==x['sha256Before']==x['sha256After']
    assert len(raw)==x['bytesBefore']==x['bytesAfter'] and x['unchanged'] is True
assert {x['path'] for x in ds['mutableContext']}==CONTEXTS
for x in ds['mutableContext']:
    rel=Path(x['path']).relative_to(REPO).as_posix()
    raw=Path(x['path']).read_bytes(); old=git('show',BEFORE+':'+rel)
    assert sha(raw)==x['sha256After'] and len(raw)==x['bytesAfter']
    assert any(sha(b)==x['sha256Before'] and len(b)==x['bytesBefore'] for b in variants(old))
    assert norm(raw)==norm(git('show',HEAD+':'+rel))
obs=ds['parentContextObservation']; names=[Path(x['path']).relative_to(REPO).as_posix() for x in ds['mutableContext']]
assert obs['briefCheckpoint']==BEFORE and obs['headAtFinalSourceRead']==HEAD

assert obs['workingContextDiff']==''

    assert ref['sha256']==x['sha256'] and ref['bytes']==x['bytes']
    b=Path(x['target']).read_bytes(); assert sha(b)==x['sha256'] and len(b)==x['bytes']
assert len(ds['indexBindings'])==h['indexBindingCount']==53

assert readback['mutableContextChangedSinceFinalCapture']==[]
